metadata.question: Between December 2021 and January 2022, was the mean snow cover on Villarrica greater than the 2000 to 2020 average for the same months?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Villarrica (volcano in Chile, ~39.42°S, 71.93°W) - Time periods: Dec 2021-Jan 2022 vs Dec-Jan average from 2000-2020 - Collection: MODIS Snow Cover (MOD10A1.061 or MCD43A4 NDSI) - MOD10A1 has NDSI_Snow_Cover band 2. Masking strategy: - Use MODIS snow cover product directly (NDSI_Snow_Cover band, values 0-100%) - May need to mask clouds/missing data - Calculate mean snow cover percentage 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero: Mean snow cover could legitimately be 0% (no snow) - C1: No images found for time period - C2: Images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare 2021-2022 mean vs 2000-2020 baseline mean ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Villarrica volcano geometry (Chile) const villarrica = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.93, -39.42]).buffer(5000); // 5km radius // 2. Define time periods const targetStart = '2021-12-01'; const targetEnd = '2022-02-01'; const baselineYears = ee.List.sequence(2000, 2020); // 3. Load MODIS Snow Cover data const getSnowCollection = (startDate, endDate) => { return ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(villarrica) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); }; // 4. Get target period data (Dec 2021 - Jan 2022) const targetCol = getSnowCollection(targetStart, targetEnd); const targetSize = targetCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Target period images: ${targetSize}`); if (targetSize === 0) { console.log('No images for Dec 2021-Jan 2022.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate target period mean const targetMean = targetCol.mean(); const targetStats = targetMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: villarrica, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const targetSnow = targetStats['NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean']; const targetCount = targetStats['NDSI_Snow_Cover_count']; console.log(`Target valid pixels: ${targetCount}`); if (targetCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in target period.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 6. Calculate baseline (2000-2020) Dec-Jan averages const baselineImages = baselineYears.map((year) => { const y = ee.Number(year); const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(y, 12, 1); const end = ee.Date.fromYMD(y.add(1), 2, 1); const col = getSnowCollection(start, end); return col.mean().set('year', year); }); const baselineCol = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages(baselineImages); const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline period images: ${baselineSize}`); if (baselineSize === 0) { console.log('No baseline data.'); console.log('C1'); return; } const baselineMean = baselineCol.mean(); const baselineStats = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: villarrica, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const baselineSnow = baselineStats['NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean']; const baselineCount = baselineStats['NDSI_Snow_Cover_count']; console.log(`Baseline valid pixels: ${baselineCount}`); if (baselineCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in baseline.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Validate calculations if (targetSnow === null || targetSnow === undefined || isNaN(targetSnow) || baselineSnow === null || baselineSnow === undefined || isNaN(baselineSnow)) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Compare and output results console.log(`Dec 2021-Jan 2022 mean snow: ${targetSnow.toFixed(2)}%`); console.log(`2000-2020 Dec-Jan mean snow: ${baselineSnow.toFixed(2)}%`); console.log(`Difference: ${(targetSnow - baselineSnow).toFixed(2)}%`); if (targetSnow > baselineSnow) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
